query:
UPDATE enterprise_connections SET
             name = $2,
             status = 'active',
             issuer_url = $3,
             discovery_url = $4,
             client_id = $5,
             client_secret_cipher = COALESCE($6, client_secret_cipher),
             scopes = $7,
             metadata_url = $8,
             metadata_xml = $9,
             entity_id = $10,
             acs_url = $11,
             domain_hint = $12,
             email_attribute = $13,
             name_attribute = $14,
             updated_at = now()
           WHERE id = $1 AND env_id = $15
